structured_summary: The robot announces a package delivery via speech. The user must acknowledge the delivery via speech within 8 seconds of the announcement. After receiving the acknowledgment, the robot must confirm the delivery via speech within 1 second.

obligations.source_sentence: The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (via speech) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.

missing_details: Robot's behavior if user fails to acknowledge within 8 seconds (e.g., retry, abort)
Exact start point of the timing windows (end of announcement vs. start)
Speech characteristics such as language, volume, or tone
potential_ambiguities: What constitutes a valid acknowledgment (any utterance vs. specific phrase)
Whether the 8‑second window begins at the end of the robot's announcement or at its start
Whether the robot's final confirmation must be a specific phrase or any speech
